nodes.name: Patient Flame
nodes.description: Mana regenerates 20% faster, but you cast 8% slower. Trades burst for endurance.

nodes.name: Quicksilver Catalyst
nodes.description: Arcane Bolt (Q) chains to a second nearby enemy for 40% damage. The pierce makes Q feel like an AOE without losing its single-target identity.

nodes.name: Hearthwarden's Vow
nodes.description: Healing Beacon (E) now heals 60% of the Heart's missing HP instead of a flat amount. Becomes a clutch save instead of a maintenance heal.

nodes.name: Frostfall's Echo
nodes.description: Frost Nova (W) leaves a 4u ice field for 3s after the freeze ends. Enemies entering the field are slowed 40%. Turns one freeze into zone control.

nodes.name: The Last Lantern
nodes.description: Meteor Strike (R) leaves a fire pool that burns for 5s, dealing 30 dps to anything inside. Turns R from a single big hit into a damage zone.

nodes.name: Aelwyn's Will
nodes.description: When the Heart drops below 25% HP, all your cooldowns refresh and your next 3 casts cost no mana. The panic-clutch ultimate.

knight._comment: Two-kind tree (heal+ranged spine). TIER-1 nodes are SKILL nodes: each carries an 'abilityId' into knight-skills (abilities.json) and the loadout chooser EQUIPS it into a W/E/R slot. TIER-2/3 nodes are STAT nodes: passive damageBonus / cdReduction folded class-wide by HeroTalentModifiers (unchanged mechanism). Q stays the locked basic attack — never in this tree.

nodes.name: Throwing Spear
nodes.description: SKILL — equip a ranged spear poke (28 dmg at 16m). Gives the Knight a ranged opener.

nodes.name: Mending Salve
nodes.description: SKILL — equip a self-heal (42 HP). The Knight's sustain.

nodes.name: Snare Arrow
nodes.description: SKILL — equip a ranged snare (18 dmg + slow). Locks a runner down.

nodes.name: Shield Bash
nodes.description: SKILL — equip a melee bash + snare (22 dmg). Up-close control.

nodes.name: Suppressing Volley
nodes.description: SKILL — equip a cleaving volley (36 dmg arc). The Knight's ultimate sweep.

nodes.name: Honed Edge
nodes.description: STAT — +15% ability damage and -10% cooldown, class-wide. Sharpens the whole kit.

nodes.name: Twined Cord
nodes.description: Quick Shot (Q) range increases by 40%. Wren's signature reach.

nodes.name: The Forest Knows
nodes.description: You move 15% faster while outside the village walls (in the elemental zones). Encourages exploration and harvesting between waves.

nodes.name: Sela's Patience
nodes.description: Snare Arrow (W) now also marks the target — your next 3 Quick Shots at them deal +60% damage. Pairs setup with payoff.

nodes.name: Hawk's Mercy
nodes.description: Hawk's Eye (E) marks 3 nearby enemies instead of 1, but crit multiplier drops from 200% to 150%. Trade focus for spread.

nodes.name: The Greenmarch Volley
nodes.description: Volley (R) ticks 6 times instead of 4, and arrows lightly seek toward enemies (~20% homing). Wider effective area + better hit rate.

nodes.name: Heartwood Whisper
nodes.description: When an enemy you've marked with Hawk's Eye dies, the cooldown of Hawk's Eye refreshes by 50%. Chains kills together.

notes: Ported from docs/hero-talent-trees-spec.md. Six talents per hero across three tiers (two columns each). Tier costs: 1/2/3 Wisdom. A full tree costs 6 Wisdom. Tier N+1 nodes require the same-column tier N node to be learned.
